rules.title: innerHTML assignment
rules.message: innerHTML is an XSS sink if the right-hand side includes untrusted data.
rules.fix: Use textContent, or sanitize with a maintained sanitizer and a strict allowlist.

rules.title: document.write
rules.message: document.write can inject HTML/script into the document.
rules.fix: Replace with DOM APIs that set text or sanitized nodes.

rules.title: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML
rules.message: React HTML injection sink. Safe only with trusted, sanitized markup.
rules.fix: Sanitize HTML server-side or with DOMPurify; prefer structured components.
